name: Codec-Adaptive TriPlane Radiance Fields
definition: A compression framework for plane-factorized radiance fields that optimizes neural features directly in the decoded space of a standard codec by inserting a real codec round-trip into the training loop via STE.
summary: Codec-Adaptive TriPlane Radiance Fields is a compression framework that optimizes neural features directly within standard video or image codecs to prevent rendering degradation at low bitrates without requiring learned parameters.
